About

I am a PhD candidate in the Security of Software (SOS) Group at Penn State, advised by Dr. G. Gary Tan. My research sits at the intersection of program analysis and machine learning, focusing on making static analysis of compiled binaries practical, scalable, and precise — and more recently on agentic security: characterizing capability boundaries and attack surfaces of LLM-based autonomous agents.

Before Penn State, I spent five years as a Research Scientist at Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), India's premier nuclear research facility, where I built trusted systems, industrial control-network security tooling, and ensemble malware classifiers for host protection.

I hold an M.Tech from IIT Roorkee (CGPA 9.765/10, DGFS Fellow, DAE) and a B.Tech from Govt. College of Engineering & Textile Technology, Serampore. I ranked in the top 0.1% nationally in GATE CS 2015.

The Pennsylvania State University
2022 – present
PhD Candidate — The SOS Group
State College, PA, USA
Agent Capability Model (ACaM) — Agentic security analysis
  • Developing a static + LLM-augmented pipeline to characterize security properties of LLM-based autonomous agents: taint tracking, capability boundary detection, and attack-surface enumeration.
  • Evaluating against real-world agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen) and synthesizing ground-truth benchmarks for controlled ablation.
DISA — Learning-guided static disassembly & CFG recovery
  • Designed a transformer-based disassembly framework jointly recovering code layout and memory block boundaries on large stripped binaries.
  • Integrated memory block boundaries into a downstream block-level VSA-driven CFG recovery tool, improving control-flow via sound indirect call resolution.
iResolveX — Hybrid indirect-call resolution
  • Multi-stage pipeline coupling high-recall target supersets with ML-guided re-ranking and bounded inter-procedural evidence support.
  • Produces p-IndirectCFG: a practical ranked-edge CFG enabling controllable precision–recall tradeoffs for IDA/Ghidra/angr consumers.
Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
2017 – 2022
Research Scientist, Grade C → D
Maharashtra, India
Automated Multilayered Malware Classifier (2019–2022)
  • Designed and deployed an ensemble classifier combining basic/advanced static and dynamic analysis; introduced CFG-driven shallow+deep features integrated with an Application Whitelisting framework.
Binary Vulnerability Detection via LLVM IR
  • Static analysis-driven detector for buffer overflows and memory leaks in third-party binaries; contributed LLVM IR-level data flow-analysis checks.
Trusted Systems for I&C Networks (2017–2019)
  • Designed the in-house Hardware Reference Monitor (PCIe & USB): Secure Boot, Authentication, Remote Attestation for host/guest Linux and Windows.
  • Advanced Industrial Control Firewall (Modbus/TCP): DPI-based kernel module for application-layer policy enforcement between field and supervisory networks.
